name: Taiyuan LC-9
tagline: Long March 2D / 4B / 4C polar-orbit workhorse — Yaogan, Gaofen, weather sats
description: Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center's LC-9 (also known as Pad 9) handles most of TYSC's polar and sun-synchronous orbit launches with the Long March 2D, 4B, 4C, and 6A. Typical payloads include the Yaogan reconnaissance series, the Gaofen Earth-observation constellation, and the Fengyun meteorological satellites. Active since 2008.
best_known_for: Polar-orbit workhorse for Yaogan + Gaofen + Fengyun
